text:
maria: Packaging flagged missing `security-policy` tag in release_notes.md for private installer 1.4.4-rc1. Two options: rebuild + re-sign (delay ~30m) or ship binary + signed sidecar. Need quick call.

packaging-bot: Validator failed: missing required tag `security-policy`. Artifact built: gs://staging-artifacts/private/1.4.4/installer-1.4.4-rc1.tar.gz

sam: If contracts require embedded notes, sidecar won't cut it. Who's on compliance list?

ops: Contract check: acme-corp and healthco require embedded release notes. Others allow sidecar.

jordan: Given two compliance customers, I'd prefer rebuild and re-sign. Safer than notifying and delaying customers.

rei: Rollback criteria we should predefine: canary error_rate >2% OR median latency +120ms OR KV warmup miss >10% after 5m -> immediate rollback to 1.4.3 pinned.

ben: Also monitor packaging-agent downstream checksum reports; if >=2 customers report mismatch during canary, abort.

maria: I'll trigger autofix + rebuild now. Autofix script: ./tools/release-lint --require-tags security-policy,installer --autofix && ./scripts/build-installer.sh

packaging-bot: Job started. ETA ~22-28m. Lock TTL on staging artifacts: 40m.

maria: (25m) Rebuild finished, smoke passed. Signing and escrow upload in progress.

ops: Cosign sign done, attestations uploaded to s3://redwood-escrow/private/1.4.4/. Checksums match.

maria: Posted `release: new-bundle 1.4.4` to deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Received `release: new-bundle 1.4.4`. Canary window assigned 22:00-22:20. Monitor eng-oncall and eng-sre. Good luck.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll post canary status in-channel at T+10m.
